name: lamindbagent
description: Read a LaminDB instance's registry with the lamindb library: search and filter artifacts, collections, runs, features and labels, and describe a record with its lineage. Read only; your key goes only to Lamin.

env_vars.description: Optional LaminHub API base URL (https, a host under lamin.ai). Leave empty unless LaminHub support gave you one.
LaminDB API key from lamin.ai, sent only to lamin.ai hosts
Optional folder for the extension's own lamindb settings. Default: a folder beside Biorouter's data, so your ~/.lamin is not used.

skills.name: lamindb-data-registry
skills.description: How to call LaminDBAgent's tools: read a LaminDB instance's artifacts, collections, runs, features and labels by search, filtered queries and descriptions.
